text:
jamal: :rotating_light: Noticing a surge of 429s for a subset of API keys after the console deploy at 2026-03-17T08:12:19Z. Rate alerts started ~08:20 UTC. Any ideas on a quick mitigation?
ratebot: [ALERT] 429 spike on /v1/generate for per-key quota group 'leaky-bucket'. threshold=0.2 current=0.64. See https://console.internal/alerts/ALRT-2026-03-17-428
lina: pinging oncall. tagging @sre-team.
alex: digging into logs now — seeing many leaky_bucket rejects with set_max_burst=0 right after the console change. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T08:19:34Z leaky_drop key=org_3489 bucket=0 tokens=0 action=reject reason=burst_quota_enforced
2026-03-17T08:19:37Z leaky_set key=org_3489 set_max_burst=0 source=policy-translation v=2.4.1
2026-03-17T08:19:40Z leaky_drop key=org_9012 bucket=0 tokens=0 action=reject
```
oliver: I rolled out a console change 'burst-tuner' — default behavior changed so that an empty burst field was translated to 0 rather than omitted. I'm rolling the config translation service back to 2.4.0 now.
maria: if rollback doesn't propagate immediately, can we hotpatch the runtime to treat max_burst==0 as 'unset'?
alex: yes, quick patch ready. Will push a runtime hotfix that treats 0 as null for per-key policy during enforcement. Pushing PR now, will merge after CI smoke.
jamal: rollback started at 08:27 UTC. monitoring dashboard: https://console.internal/d/quotas/per-key?from=08:10&to=08:40
ratebot: [RECOVERY] 429 rate down to baseline for affected keys (0.06) at 08:36 UTC :white_check_mark:
oliver: confirmed rollback reverted translation change. No changes to stored customer config, just translation layer.
maria: alex — can you post the PR link and ETA for the runtime patch? We should avoid another window where translation could slip through.
alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4325 — tests pass, deploying canary to canary-runtime-2 at 08:42. ETA full roll 09:00 UTC.
jamal: thanks. immediate customer impact looks limited to ~30 org-keys, mostly low-burst customers. Ops will reach out to any impacted customers.
devex-bot: action added: postmortem task: "console: clarify burst field semantics and add explicit 'leave blank to keep' tooltip" assigned to @oliver, due 2026-03-24.
oliver: noted, will follow up with UX. Also adding server-side guard: never write max_burst=0 on translation, treat empty as omit.
maria: follow-up item: add telemetry to record when translation sets explicit max_burst vs omitted. Missing metric made debugging slower.
alex: adding metric: policy_translation.set_to_zero_count and alert if >0 in a deploy window.
lina: reassigning oncall to SRE rotation for postmortem. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
jamal: final: incident closed at 08:40 UTC, root cause = console translation bug that mapped empty burst field -> 0 which enforced strict per-key burst limits. Follow-ups recorded.
